name: Multiplayer Leaderboard
author: MultiplayerLeaderboard
description: Shows a live multiplayer leaderboard in a fixed world-space panel above the song-progress HUD: rank, player name, accuracy and current score.
Adds a Multiplayer Leaderboard button to Beat Saber's Mods pane with dedicated Positioning, Rotation, Scaling, Appearance, Text and Displayed Information pages, each with its own Back button.
Rotation can be adjusted with pointer drag mode or precise X/Y/Z controls and is saved independently from position. Displayed columns can be hidden without stopping their tracking.

Test Mode keeps a clearly labelled PREVIEW panel visible outside multiplayer so it can be positioned with the game's laser pointer, including while a song is paused. Turning Test Mode off restores multiplayer-only visibility without clearing saved settings.
Scores and accuracy are read from the game's own multiplayer score sync state. Nothing is estimated or invented; a value that is not available yet is shown as a dash.
The panel is created at a fixed position and never follows or rotates with the headset. Writes diagnostics to Logs/MultiplayerLeaderboard/MultiplayerLeaderboard.log.
